<thought>To identify the product (target molecule) that was used in the previous step, I will remove the protecting groups from each of the three precursor SMILES returned earlier. The deprotected structures should converge to the same core molecule, which is the target of the retrosynthetic step. This will give me the SMILES of the target molecule needed to search for the appropriate Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons template.</thought>
<action>deprotect_molecule</action>
